verdict.rationale: Embedded white-label payroll is a fair question for a payroll platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows APIs, a CLI and an App Shop for third parties to build integrations that extend Rippling itself. That is the reverse direction. Nothing shows a partner API for embedding Rippling payroll, white-labeled, inside a developer's own product.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API
